svg.title: Red Curve VI
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry; interpretive colours. Sweeping upper arc and pointed lower corner preserved; control points approximate. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://high.org/collection/red-curve-vi/; reviewed 2026-10-26; not a facsimile.
